prompt: Users can now choose to get alerts by SMS instead of email; store the choice in a new `channel` field on `User`, "email" or "sms". Texts go through `SmsGateway.send` in src/gateways.ts, and `buildService` in src/app.ts already receives the gateway. Wire it up.
